Its valid-snapshot assertions also remain true if the removed no-snapshot fallbacks are restored. Existing CLI coverage mocks the API at apps/core/test/unit/cli/memory-review-command.test.ts:15. Add regression-sensitive coverage through the required entry points and include it in the repository test command; package.json:86 currently runs only unit and integration suites.

findings.body: The branch deletes both legacy-typing tests without replacing them with coverage for the new rejection behavior. Remaining transport coverage supplies ordered envelopes and mocks the stream (apps/core/test/unit/control/sdk-transport.test.ts:644 and :662), so restoring the deleted legacy branch would escape detection. Add the required API/database/Playwright coverage through actual SDK event consumption, verifying that an envelope-less typing event cannot establish typing state before an ordered baseline exists, and wire it into the repository suite.

why: Two leftover code paths support data shapes the product no longer produces: memory reviews without a snapshot, and SDK typing events without ordering info
